decision.observation: Turn 1 vs 3 Sentries (42/42, 41/41, 44/44, all Artifact). Middle sentry attacks for 10; outer two show spiral (non-attack) intents. Hand: Defend, Ascender's Bane, Defend, Inflame, Impervious. 10/80 HP, 3/3 energy.
decision.hypothesis: Only 10 damage incoming, so two Defends (10 block) fully prevent damage at 10 HP; Inflame can then add Strength with the last energy.
decision.memory: Sentry spiral intent = Dazed-adding move, not an attack. Artifact negates Vulnerable from Bash/Thunderclap until stripped.
